contract_requests: index.html must load css/uc-collab.css and js/uc-collab.js after js/unicircle.js (UC must exist; the script returns silently otherwise)
Profile page: call UCCollab.mountInbox(el); buttons use data-uc-collab data-uc-peer=<id> data-name=<name>
open_points: closed mode disables submit as specified, so a reply-allowed member cannot send via the dialog; use UC.openChat for replies
duplicate-pending detection is a regex on the server message (unique|already|duplicate|pending)
UC.avatarUrl falls back to local initials if missing
selfcheck: node --check passes; all record strings escaped; ids validated with /^[a-z0-9]{1,32}$/i before filters; not run in a browser
